Subject: MAP kickoff: draft & timeline options (Borealis Analytics)

Hi Liam / Emma —

Thanks again for the time today — great discussion. As promised, attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft for the Borealis <> Redwood engagement. The doc captures the milestones we talked through on the call and a couple of timeline options so we can align on next steps.

High-level recap / proposed MAP (initial draft):
- Discovery complete: 10/20/2026 (done) — Owner: Borealis (Liam / Emma)
- Technical validation (PoC infra + sample dataset): target week of 10/27 — Owner: Redwood (Aditya)
- Security & compliance review (SOC 2 checklist + data handling): target week of 11/3 — Owner: Borealis (Security) / Redwood (Monica)
- Procurement & legal (SOW + T&Cs): target week of 11/10 — Owner: Borealis (Procurement) / Redwood Legal
- Contract signature / go-live plan: target close: 2026-11-10 (proposed)

Dependencies we noted:
- Access to a representative sample dataset for perf tests (Borealis)
- Procurement timeline and PO cadence (Borealis)
- Technical contact for infra/networking (to be confirmed)

Ask: can you confirm the stakeholders above (and the procurement contact) so I can update owners in the MAP? Also please pick a kickoff meeting time from the options below so we can lock the PoC timeline:
- Wed, Oct 27 — 10:00 AM PT (preferred)
- Thu, Oct 28 — 9:00 AM PT

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (attached, 12 KB)
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3mapdraft
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/20481

If those dates don't work, tell me a couple of alternatives and we'll accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this rolling.

Best,
Marissa Cole
